title: Contents Packout & Storage Insurance Proceeds Posting Rules
content:
Contents-coverage insurance proceeds are posted to a Contents Packout & Storage job under these rules.

## Rules for posting contents-coverage proceeds

1. The job must be in in custody, return scheduled, returned or invoiced status when insurance proceeds are posted.
2. The carrier payment must be a contents-coverage payment recorded on the same claim file this job is linked to.
3. It must have reached the company directly or by a two-party check the insured has endorsed.
4. A carrier payment is posted to the same contents job at most once.
5. The amount posted is the lesser of the job's balance due less every storage and valuation line billed to the customer that is still unpaid, and the carrier payment's unapplied remainder after earlier postings from it; customer-billed storage and declared-value coverage are never paid from insurance proceeds.

## What the records must show

| Test | Record |
|---|---|
| job status | in custody, return scheduled, returned or invoiced |
| same claim file, contents coverage | the carrier payment as recorded on the Insurance Claim Services claim file the job is linked to, with its coverage part |
| how the money arrived | directly to the company, or a two-party check the insured has endorsed |
| not yet posted here | no earlier posting of that carrier payment to this job |

## Amount posted

The amount is the lesser of two figures:
- the job's balance due, less every storage and valuation line billed to the customer that is still unpaid; and
- the carrier payment's unapplied remainder after earlier postings from it.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).** A job's balance due is 2,400.00, of which 300.00 is unpaid customer-billed storage and declared-value coverage; the first figure is 2,100.00. A carrier payment of 5,000.00 from which 3,500.00 was posted earlier has a remainder of 1,500.00. The amount posted is the lesser, 1,500.00.
